design_rationale.problem: R1-004 seam extraction moved _ACTIVE_SPEND_TRACKER to costing.py module level. Dual importlib loads of v5 (which tests do) can get different costing module objects with divergent tracker state. CLI introspection goldens cannot catch module-identity issues.
design_rationale.solution: Create dedicated _spend_tracker_registry.py module that is pinned in sys.modules. All access to tracker state goes through this module's singleton registry. Even if costing.py is reloaded, registry module stays cached with same identity.
mechanism: Registry is a dedicated module (not imported and reloaded)
Python's sys.modules cache ensures single instance
Registry holds SpendTrackerState via class instance attribute
Thread-safe lock in registry protects concurrent access
Context manager (with_lock) for sustained lock ownership

behavior_tested: Registry identity stable across module reload
Tracker state persists after module reload
Tracker object identity preserved (same object, not just equal objects)
Multiple imports access same tracker instance
